versions.changelog:
AutoPlantUMLEdit 1.0.0 – Convert natural language to fully editable UML diagrams in PowerPoint.

- Converts user requests in natural language into PlantUML diagrams (sequence, class, activity, state, use case).
- Exports UML diagrams to PPTX, EMF, SVG, or PNG formats; PPTX/EMF are fully ungroupable/editable in PowerPoint.
- Provides clear trigger phrases, usage flow, and script commands for generating and exporting diagrams.
- Includes comprehensive reference and strict notes for filename restrictions, language limitations (swimlane/participant names in English), and dependency setup (Inkscape, JDK, Python packages).
- Offers detailed user instructions for editing exported diagrams and troubleshooting encoding issues.
